units.source: Launch bar widgets are a subset of __TRILIUM_PH_0__Custom Widgets__TRILIUM_PH_1__ that can be used to render custom buttons and widgets inside the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
Creating a launch bar widget for the desktop layout__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Launch Bar Widgets > Creating a launch bar widget for the desktop layout

units.source: Unlike __TRILIUM_PH_0__Custom Widgets__TRILIUM_PH_1__, the process of setting up a launch bar widget is slightly different:
units.context: Launch Bar Widgets > Creating a launch bar widget for the desktop layout

units.source: Create a Code note of type __TRILIUM_PH_0__JavaScript (front-end)__TRILIUM_PH_1__ or JSX (for Preact-based widgets).
units.context: Launch Bar Widgets > Creating a launch bar widget for the desktop layout

units.source: The script itself uses the same concepts as __TRILIUM_PH_0__Custom Widgets__TRILIUM_PH_1__, including the use of a __TRILIUM_PH_2__ or a __TRILIUM_PH_3__ (according to needs).
units.context: Launch Bar Widgets > Creating a launch bar widget for the desktop layout

units.source: As examples in both legacy and Preact format, see __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note Title Widget__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and __TRILIUM_PH_2__Analog Watch__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
units.context: Launch Bar Widgets > Creating a launch bar widget for the desktop layout

units.source: Don't set __TRILIUM_PH_0__, as that attribute is reserved for __TRILIUM_PH_1__Custom Widgets__TRILIUM_PH_2__.
units.context: Launch Bar Widgets > Creating a launch bar widget for the desktop layout
Launch Bar Widgets > Creating a launch bar widget for the desktop layout

units.source: In the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Visible Launchers__TRILIUM_PH_1__ section, select __TRILIUM_PH_2__Add a custom widget__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
units.context: Launch Bar Widgets > Creating a launch bar widget for the desktop layout

units.source: Give the newly created launcher a name (and optionally a name).
units.context: Launch Bar Widgets > Creating a launch bar widget for the desktop layout

units.source: In the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Promoted Attributes__TRILIUM_PH_1__ section, modify the __TRILIUM_PH_2__widget__TRILIUM_PH_3__ field to point to the newly created note.
units.context: Launch Bar Widgets > Creating a launch bar widget for the desktop layout
Launch Bar Widgets > Creating a launch bar widget for the desktop layout

units.source: Custom launch bar widgets are also supported on the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Mobile Frontend__TRILIUM_PH_1__. To do so:
Look for __TRILIUM_PH_0__Mobile Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and follow the same creation mechanism as in the previous section.
